title: Calling the Claude API from the browser fails with a CORS error or a browser-like environment error
symptoms: It looks like you're running in a browser-like environment. This is disabled by default, as it risks exposing your secret API credentials to attackers.
fetch to api.anthropic.com from a web page is blocked by CORS
cause: The TypeScript SDK refuses to run in a browser unless dangerouslyAllowBrowser is set, and the API grants cross-origin requests only when the anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access header is present, which that option adds.
fix: Call the API from a server route and keep the key there. Only for bring-your-own-key tools where the user supplies their own key, set dangerouslyAllowBrowser true.
apply: const client = new Anthropic({ apiKey: userSuppliedKey, dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true }); // raw fetch: add header 'anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access': 'true'
